summary: Wipro Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to furnish its Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26, submitted to Indian stock exchanges and the NYSE on June 22, 2026. The filing includes a letter to exchanges and a detailed sustainability report covering the period April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026. No corporate transaction, share issuance, or structural change is described. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms or corporate events are present.
